AEGIS — Extension Demo Fixtures

All credentials here are fake. Serve this over http://localhost (see the demo script) so the extension treats it as a secure origin; loading it via file:// will not work, because content scripts only match http/https.

1 · Login form (expect: offer saved credentials, no generator panel)

2 · Signup form (expect: AEGIS suggestion panel on focus, fills both fields)

3 · Password change form (expect: suggestion panel on the NEW password field only)

4 · Dynamically inserted signup form (expect: detected after insertion, exactly one panel)

5 · Payment form (expect: AEGIS never engages)

The password field here is intentionally present — AEGIS should still stay out because the surrounding form contains payment fields.

6 · Unknown form (expect: no engagement)
